observations: Three photos show a stack of white multifunction printers wrapped in clear plastic.
The brand 'RICOH' is visible on the front panel of the top unit in all photos.
The top unit has a paper output tray with a document on it.
A colorful sticker with 'Fancy' and images of cakes and food is attached to the front.
The printers appear to be in a warehouse or storage area with other similar units stacked around.
No model number is visible on the front or top of any unit in the photos.
The seller's text mentions 'MP C4504ex/MP C6004ex', but no such model is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: The MP C4504ex/MP C6004ex multifunction color systems are ideal for fast-paced...
claims.evidence: The model numbers are not visible in the photos. The seller's text claims specific models, but no visual proof confirms them.

risks.risk: The printer may not be the claimed model (C4504ex or C6004ex).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label on the front or top of the printer.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic RICOH multifunction printer, not as the specific model claimed.

risks.risk: The printer may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, printing a test page, and scanning.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, since functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The printer may have been used in a high-dust or industrial environment, affecting print quality or internal components.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the internal components or a video showing the paper feed and toner area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown wear, assuming moderate to heavy use.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the original packaging.
A clear photo of the model label on the front or top of the printer.
A video showing the printer powering on and printing a test page.
A close-up photo of the internal paper tray and toner area.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
